info.title: Atlan Raw REST API (from developer.atlan.com)
info.description:
OpenAPI spec generated from Atlan developer documentation pages (developer.atlan.com).

Notes:
- This spec is best-effort and derived from documentation examples.
- Many request/response schemas are inferred from examples and may be incomplete.
- All endpoints require Bearer token authentication.

bearerAuth.description: Atlan API token (Bearer). Generate in Atlan Settings → API Tokens.
